blurb: Guests can take various tours including train rides, airplane and jeep tours, helicopter flights, and VIP scenic drives. Tours include visits to the Grand Canyon, Valley of Fire, Hollywood, and Monument Valley with narrated experiences and photo opportunities. Some tours include meals and hotel pick-up and drop-off services.
